divergence_justification: Judge accepted the gap-shaped review: MIMIC_NOTES.md:55-59 records no MIMIC-specific Patient anchor extension, and MIMIC_NOTES.md:128-147 records that Patient.birthDate collapses and does not exactly preserve anchor_age or anchor_year; minimum Encounter.period.start year is only an approximation. The current full comparison verified typed NULLs on anchor_age and anchor_year for all 431,231 rows, with 0 conflicts, 0 only-candidate, 0 only-oracle, and 431,231/431,231 representable rows exact. Every defensible mapping was tried. The loss is ancillary: admissions, hadm_id grain, subject, admittime, and derived age are exact and the missing anchor outputs do not alter inclusion, keys, grouping, carry-forward, or remaining clinical values.

reopen_history.reason:
Downstream SQL-on-FHIR consumers join derived tables on getResourceKey() resource keys, which this port computes as
  its join spine but drops at the outermost SELECT. The attempt adds patient_key and encounter_key beside subject_id
  and hadm_id, per the manifest's key_columns. Additive and shape-only: both comparison paths project manifest columns
  explicitly, so no compared value can change. Also requires adding getResourceKey() to ViewDefinition.encounter.json,
  which currently projects only a reference key.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: Intrinsic representability gap, upstream-ETL-confirmed. 430,727/431,231 rows (99.883%) identical on all representable columns. age conflicts on 460 rows (0.107%): mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_patient.sql:15 synthesises Patient.birthDate as MIN(transfers.intime)-anchor_age, not anchor_year-anchor_age; canonical age needs anchor_year, which no FHIR element carries. admittime conflicts on 44 rows (0.010%): fhir_encounter.sql:65 casts through TIMESTAMPTZ, normalising DST-gap wall times irreversibly. anchor_age/anchor_year emitted as typed NULLs per contract. Divergence propagates to creatinine_baseline, oasis, charlson, sapsii, which all select age.

reopen_history.superseded_justification: Intrinsic upstream transformation divergence. mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_patient.sql:15,108 synthesizes Patient.birthDate from MIN(transfers.intime)-anchor_age, while canonical mimic-iv/concepts/demographics/age.sql:30 requires the unrecoverable anchor_age/anchor_year pair, explaining all 460 age conflicts. mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_encounter.sql:65,149-151 irreversibly normalizes 44 DST-gap admission times, exhaustively replayed by the comparator. The anchor outputs are valid ancillary typed NULLs; all rows, keys, and grain are preserved. Under the contract's explicit birthDate and DST upstream-defect exemptions, these conflicts are accepted rather than blocked, including their clinically meaningful effect on age.
